theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)  := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let v (n : ℕ) : Set.Icc B T := ⟨u n, hB n⟩
  let f := fun n => (v n, v (n + 1), v (n + 2), v (n + 3))
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ := Set.finite_univ.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    (f := f) (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  have hr n := (hu (n + 4) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)).1
  have he' : ∀ m, f (i + m) = f (j + m) := Nat.rec he fun m ih => by
      simp only [f, v, Prod.mk.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq, Nat.add_succ] at ih ⊢
      simp only [ih, true_and]
      apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
      simp only [hr, Nat.reduceSubDiff, Nat.add_succ, ih]
  refine ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  rw [Nat.add_right_comm i m, Nat.add_sub_of_le hij.le]
  exact (congrArg (fun x => x.1.val) (he' m)).symm
